situation: I'm organising a surprise 40th for my friend Claire on Saturday 10 October, and Osteria Rosa, where we'd booked 18 people, just cancelled after a flood in their kitchen. A few people booked trains for it, and I've got holds at two other places near the station. Need to tell the group chat.
reply: Bad news, everyone: Osteria Rosa cancelled our booking for Saturday the 10th this morning, they've had a flood in the kitchen. I know a few of you booked trains around it. The date stays the same; I've got holds at two other places near the station and I'll confirm one by Sunday. Still very much on.
note: News in the first line, one line of why, acknowledge the cost to them, then what happens next.

situation: 我是部门经理，公司今年冻结调薪，我得告诉组里的小陈，她之前一直在等这次涨薪，我也答应过帮她争取。打算先发消息约她聊。
reply: 小陈，有件事想直接跟你说，不太是好消息。今年公司冻结调薪，你的涨薪这次没有批下来。我知道你一直在等，我之前也跟你说过会争取，这个结果我很抱歉。明天上午10点我们当面聊一下，我想跟你一起定一个明年上半年的具体目标，到时候我拿着它再去提。
note: 消息放在前两句，不用模糊的'可能有点难'。当面聊比文字好，所以消息里先说清楚，再约时间。

situation: I'm Sam, a freelance dev. The one-tap wallet payments I promised my client Rachel for her Nov 1 launch turn out to be only on her payment provider's enterprise tier; their support confirmed it this morning. I can launch with cards only or add a second provider, which adds about a week, and I need to email her.
reply:
Hi Rachel,
I'll get straight to it: one-tap wallet payments can't be added on your current payment provider's plan, so they won't be in the 1 November launch. I checked with the provider's support this morning and the feature is only on their enterprise tier. I know that was one of the features you wanted for launch. Two options: launch on the 1st with card payments as planned, or I add a second provider alongside your current one, which adds about a week. Happy to talk it through on a call tomorrow if that's easier.
Sam
note: No three paragraphs before the news. If she's upset, don't defend; restate the two options and let her choose.

situation: Borrowed my friend Nick's car for the weekend and this afternoon scraped the passenger door reversing out of a parking space: a hand-width scratch and a small dent, and I've taken photos. My fault entirely. He only got it back from the garage last month.
reply: Nick, I've got some news you won't love: I scraped the passenger door of your car reversing out of a parking space this afternoon. There's a scratch about a hand's width long and a small dent, photos attached. I'm really sorry, I know you only just got it back from the garage. I'll pay for the repair in full, at whichever garage you trust, and I can drop it there myself. Call me tonight if you want to talk it through.
note: When it's your fault, say it plainly with no excuse, and offer to pay before he has to ask.

situation: 我和室友小周合租两年了，合同明年1月15号到期。我决定到期不续了，要搬去和男朋友住，她得自己找新室友或者换房子。她挺喜欢这套房子的。
reply: 小周，有件事想早点告诉你，可能不是你想听的：1月15号合同到期后，我不打算续租了，要搬去和男朋友一起住。我知道这样你得重新找室友或者换房，挺折腾的，所以提前三个多月跟你说。找室友我可以帮你发朋友圈、一起见人，跟房东交接押金的事也我来跑。今晚回来我们当面聊聊？
note: 消息放在前两句，承认对她的影响，再给具体的帮忙；大事发完消息还要当面聊。

situation: Yesterday I texted my sister Hannah that I can't lend her the $3,000 for her car repair after all, because my hours at work got cut; I could drive her to work next week instead. She replied 'Great, thanks for nothing, you promised.' I don't want a fight, but I can't change my answer.
reply: You're right, I did promise, and I'm sorry to go back on it. With my hours cut I can't lend the $3,000, and I know that leaves you stuck without the car. What I can do is drive you to work next week while you sort out the repair. Take whatever time you need, I'm not going anywhere.
note: When they react badly, don't argue with the reaction or reopen the decision: own the broken promise, restate the news once, offer what you can and stay available.

situation: I coach my town's U12 girls' soccer team, and at last weekend's tryouts 26 girls went for 16 travel squad spots. Zoe, 11, two seasons with us, didn't make it because of her speed on the ball; she has a rec team spot and can join our Thursday skills sessions before spring tryouts. I need to text her mom, Karen, before the list goes out tomorrow.
reply: Hi Karen, I wanted you to hear this from me before the list goes out tomorrow, and it isn't the news Zoe was hoping for. She didn't make the travel squad this season. We had 26 girls for 16 spots, and it came down to speed on the ball, which is something she can absolutely build. I know how much the team means to her after two seasons. She has a spot on the rec team, and I'd love her at our Thursday skills sessions so she's ready for spring tryouts. Happy to call tonight if you'd like to talk it through.
note: Warn, give the news in line two, one honest reason framed as something she can work on, then a real path forward and a call.

situation: I'm in the second year of a law degree and my parents put in $12,000 a year toward it. I've decided to leave at the end of this semester, in December, start an electrician apprenticeship with Carver Electric in January and cover my own costs from then on. I'm calling them Sunday, what do I actually say?
reply: Have you both got a few minutes? I've got news you probably won't love, and I wanted to tell you myself rather than by text. I'm leaving law school at the end of this semester, in December. I'm starting an electrician apprenticeship with Carver Electric in January. I know you've put $12,000 a year into this and believed in it, and I don't take that lightly. From January I'll cover my own costs, and I'd like to walk you through the whole plan.
note: Too big for a text: a call, the news by the third line, one reason, what it means for them, then the plan. Let them react before you explain more.

situation: 邻居刘姐出差一周，托我喂她的猫年糕。今天下午我开门拿快递，年糕从门缝溜出去了，找了两个小时还没找到，已经在业主群发了照片，物业也在帮忙查监控。她明天晚上才回来，我得现在告诉她。
reply: 刘姐，有个不好的消息得马上告诉你：今天下午我开门拿快递，年糕从门缝跑出去了，是我没看住。我已经找了两个小时，还没找到。业主群里发了照片，物业也在帮忙查监控，晚上我带着它的猫粮和小毯子再去楼下找。真的对不起，我知道你现在肯定特别着急。一有消息我马上告诉你，想打电话的话我随时在。
note: 第一句就把事情说清楚，承担责任但不长篇解释，然后说已经在做什么、接下来怎么办。

situation: My old university friend Dev was diagnosed with bowel cancer last week and starts chemo on Monday 12 October. He asked me to tell our friends, including Sophie in Canada, who was close to him; he'd love messages but would rather not take calls for now. I'm texting Sophie.
reply: Sophie, I wanted you to hear this from me rather than through the grapevine, and it isn't good news. Dev was diagnosed with bowel cancer last week, and he starts chemo on Monday 12 October. He asked me to let the people close to him know. He'd love a message from you, though he'd rather not take calls for now. I know this is a lot to take in from so far away, so call me any time if you want to talk it through.
note: News about someone else: say they asked you to share it, pass on what they want from people, and keep the medical detail to what they told you.

situation: I'm Ruth, and I've run Crumb & Co, a small bakery in Leeds, for seven years. The landlord is doubling the rent at renewal, so we're closing on Saturday Oct 31. I need to email our mailing list of about 900 people, a lot of them regulars.
reply:
Hi everyone,
I've got news I hoped I'd never send: Crumb & Co will close for good on Saturday 31 October. Our rent is doubling at renewal, and a bakery our size can't carry that. After seven years of you coming through our door, I know this is a loss for many of you too. We're open as normal until the 31st, every cake order already placed will be made, and loyalty cards can be used right up to closing. Come in and say hello before then, I'd love to see you.
Ruth
note: With hundreds of readers, the news goes in line one and the practical questions (orders, loyalty cards) are answered before anyone has to ask.

situation: 我和老公在多伦多，今年春节不回国了，三月我要论文答辩，机票也贵了一倍，打算五一回去住两个星期。我爸妈每年从十月就开始盼、开始准备年货。想先在微信上跟他们说清楚，再约视频。
reply: 爸妈，有件事想早点跟你们说，免得你们白准备：今年春节我们不回去了。主要是我三月份论文答辩，那段时间走不开，机票也比平时贵了一倍。我知道你们一直盼着过年一家人团聚，这次让你们失望了。我们打算五一放假回去住两个星期，好好陪你们。这周六晚上你们那边九点，视频聊聊好吗？
note: 家人会提前准备的事，坏消息越早说越好；文字先说清楚，再约视频，给对方消化的时间。

situation: I'm an account manager. Our biggest client, Norland Freight, worth $180k a year, told me this morning they won't renew in January because a competitor, Carrow, quoted them about 30% lower; I've asked their COO for a call next week. I need to tell my VP, Dana, before Friday's forecast call.
reply: Hi Dana, I've got bad news and wanted you to hear it from me before Friday's forecast call: Norland Freight told me this morning they won't renew in January. The reason is price; Carrow quoted them about 30% less. That takes $180k out of next year's number, and I know it lands hard on the forecast. I've asked their COO for a call next week to see whether anything short of matching price would change it, and I'll have a revised forecast to you by Thursday noon. Can we take 15 minutes tomorrow to talk it through?
note: Upward bad news: the number, the reason and your next move in one message, before the meeting where it would surface.

situation: We're moving from Denver to Seattle in January for my wife's new job. Our son Max is 8 and his best friend Leo lives next door. We want to tell him this weekend before he overhears it. What do I actually say?
reply: Max, we've got some big news, and some of it you might not like. In January we're moving to a new house in Seattle, because Mom has a new job there. That means we won't live next door to Leo anymore, and it's okay to feel sad or cross about that. You and Leo can video call whenever you want, and we'll ask his parents if he can come and stay with us next summer. You can ask us anything about it, today or any day.
note: With a child, the same shape in smaller words: warn, say it plainly, name the loss he'll care about most, and only promise what you'll actually arrange.

situation: Our nanny Rosa has looked after our twin girls for three years. They start full-day school in January, so we won't need her after Friday Dec 18. We're telling her in person tonight and want to follow up with a text, and we'll pay her four extra weeks.
reply: Rosa, thank you for hearing us out tonight. To put it in writing: with the girls starting full-day school in January, your last day with us will be Friday 18 December, and we'll pay you four extra weeks on top of your final pay. We know this is your income and it's a lot to take in, and we're sorry to bring it. We'd be glad to give you a glowing reference and pass your name to any families we know who are looking. You've been part of this family for three years, and the girls adore you.
note: When the news hits someone's livelihood, give the date and the money in writing early; check your employment agreement for any required notice before you set the date.

situation: I'm a wedding photographer. Aisha and Tom got married on Saturday. One of my memory cards failed and about 60 ceremony photos, including my front-on shots of the ring exchange, are gone; recovery software got nothing back. My second shooter, Jen, has the ring exchange from the side. I'm calling them this morning and want to follow up by email with a £400 refund and a free portrait session.
reply:
Hi Aisha and Tom,
Thank you for taking my call this morning. To put it in writing: one of my memory cards failed, and about 60 photos from the ceremony, including my front-on shots of the ring exchange, can't be recovered. I know those were some of the moments that mattered most to you, and I'm truly sorry. Jen, my second shooter, caught the ring exchange from the side, and those will be in your gallery. I'm refunding £400 of your fee, and I'd love to give you a free portrait session whenever suits you. I'm here any time you want to talk.
note: Your mistake, their loss: call first, then put the facts, the refund and the offer in writing without a paragraph of excuses.

situation: 我11月要搬去杭州，答应把现在租的房子从11月1日起转租给好朋友小林，她已经跟她的房东说了10月底退租。今天我去问房东，房东说合同不允许转租，不同意。不过房东说如果小林愿意直接跟他签新合同，月租5200可以谈。
reply: 小林，有个不好的消息得马上跟你说。我今天问了房东，他不同意转租，说合同不允许，所以11月1日转给你这件事办不成了。这怪我，应该先问清楚再答应你，害你已经跟房东说了退租，真的对不起。房东说如果你愿意直接跟他签新合同，月租5200可以谈；你有兴趣的话我今晚就把他的联系方式发你，不合适的话我陪你一起找房。你晚上方便的话，我给你打个电话？
note: 先说结论，再认自己的责任；把房东给的另一条路和自己能出的力一起摆出来，最后约电话。

situation: I'm renovating Mrs. Greene's bathroom. Today we lifted the old tub and found rot in two floor joists underneath, which has to be fixed before we can tile. It adds $2,400 and moves the finish from Friday Oct 9 to Wednesday Oct 14. I'm texting her photos now and would rather talk it through on a call before we go ahead.
reply: Hi Mrs. Greene, some news on the bathroom you won't love. When we lifted the old tub today we found rot in two of the floor joists underneath, and they have to be replaced before we can tile; photos attached. That adds $2,400 and moves the finish from Friday 9 October to Wednesday 14 October. I know that's more money and more days of disruption. Could I call you this evening to go through it before we do any of the extra work?
note: Surprise costs: photos, the number and the new date in one message, then a call before any extra work starts.

situation: 我和大学同学阿峰去年合伙开了一家奶茶店，各投了8万，开张时我们说好“如果续租房租涨超过20%就关店”。今天房东通知11月底续租，月租从1万涨到1万5，涨了50%。阿峰这周在外地出差，我估计把设备转卖掉每人能拿回3万左右。
reply: 阿峰，有个不太好的消息，想先跟你说。房东今天通知，11月底续租月租要从1万涨到1万5，涨了50%，按我们当初说好的超过20%就关店，这家店得关了。我知道这一年你花了多少心思，8万里大概只能拿回3万左右，我心里也很不是滋味。设备转卖和退租的事我先去问价，等你出差回来一起定。今晚你方便的话我们打个电话。
note: 先提醒一句再说结论，用两人事先的约定作为理由，把后续决定留给两个人一起做。

situation: I run a six-person design studio. On Sept 21 I offered Lena a junior designer job starting Monday Oct 19, and she has already handed in her notice at her café job. Yesterday our biggest client cancelled a $90k contract, so I can't afford the hire and have to withdraw the offer; I'm calling her at 5pm today and emailing straight after, and I can pay her $1,800 (two weeks' salary), give her a reference and introduce her to two studio owners I know.
reply: Hi Lena, following our call, I want to put this in writing. I have to withdraw the junior designer offer I made on 21 September. Yesterday our biggest client cancelled a $90k contract, and the studio can't afford a new hire right now; it has nothing to do with you or your work. I know you've already handed in your notice, and I'm truly sorry for the position this puts you in. I'll pay you $1,800, two weeks' salary, this week, give you a strong reference, and introduce you to two studio owners I know. I'm here if you want to talk again.
note: Call first, then write it down. Withdrawing an accepted offer can have legal consequences, so check the offer letter and get advice before sending.

situation: 我是硕士生导师。学生小何原计划12月答辩，但这周复核发现她第三章的实验数据有问题，得重新做，论文达不到送审要求，答辩只能推到明年6月。她已经签了明年1月入职的工作。我愿意给她的用人单位写一封说明信，也想明天下午跟她当面谈。
reply: 小何，有件事想先跟你说，不是好消息。这周复核时发现第三章的实验数据有问题，需要重新做，论文现在达不到送审要求，12月的答辩只能推到明年6月。我知道你已经签了明年1月入职的工作，这个消息对你影响很大。如果需要，我可以给用人单位写一封说明信，讲清推迟的原因。明天下午我们当面谈一次，一起把重做实验的计划定下来，你看几点方便？
note: 消息放在前两句，原因一句带过不辩解；涉及对方的工作，只承诺自己能做到的事，比如说明信。

situation: I'm the volunteer adoption coordinator at a small cat rescue. Jenny Park's family were approved last week to adopt Mochi, a two-year-old tabby, and her kids have already been talking about her; their approval carries over to any of our cats. At Mochi's pre-adoption vet check yesterday she was diagnosed with a heart condition that needs a few months of monitoring with an experienced foster, so the adoption can't go ahead, and we have two other cats, Pepper and Juno, who are great with kids and whom the family could meet this Saturday, 3 October.
reply: Hi Jenny, I've got news you won't want to hear, and I wanted to tell you straight away. At Mochi's vet check yesterday she was diagnosed with a heart condition, and she needs a few months of monitoring with one of our experienced fosters, so her adoption can't go ahead. I know the kids have already been talking about her, and I'm so sorry. Your approval still stands, and if you'd like, you could meet Pepper and Juno this Saturday, 3 October; both are great with children. No pressure at all, and I'm happy to talk on the phone if that's easier.
note: The no comes in the second sentence; the other cats are an option, not a replacement.

situation: 我和未婚夫商量好和平分手了，原定11月21日周六在南京办的婚礼取消。要在微信上给大约40位已经收到请柬的亲友发消息，已经收到的礼金我会在10月15日前一一退回。原因不想多说。
reply: 各位亲友，有个不太好的消息要告诉大家：原定11月21日在南京举行的婚礼取消了。我们俩已经商量好，和平分开，具体原因就不多说了，希望大家理解。让大家提前空出时间、费心准备，真的很抱歉。已经收到的礼金，我会在10月15日前一一退回。谢谢大家一直以来的关心，有什么想说的随时找我。
note: 群发之前，先给父母和最亲近的几位单独打个电话，别让他们从群消息里第一次知道。

situation: 家里养了12年的狗豆豆查出肝癌晚期，兽医说它已经很痛苦，建议这周六上午安乐死，我和她爸都同意了。女儿在英国读研，跟豆豆最亲，这次赶不回来。想今晚先在微信上告诉她，周六可以开视频让她陪豆豆最后一程。
reply: 闺女，有个不好的消息，想先跟你说。豆豆查出了肝癌晚期，兽医说它现在已经很痛苦，建议让它安详地走，我和你爸商量后同意了，定在这周六上午。我知道你跟豆豆最亲，人又在英国赶不回来，这个消息对你来说太难受了。周六我们开视频，你可以陪着它、跟它说说话。今晚你想聊的话，随时打给我。
note: 前两句就把事情说清，不绕弯；给她一个能参与的方式，再留出随时可以聊的口子。

situation: My neighbours Pat and Leo are away until Sunday. In last night's storm the big oak in my garden came down and flattened about 4 metres of their back fence and smashed their greenhouse; nobody was hurt and I've taken photos. I reported it to my home insurer this morning, a tree surgeon is coming Saturday morning to clear it, and I've decided to pay for the fence and greenhouse myself if insurance doesn't. Texting them now.
reply: Pat, Leo, I've got some news you won't love, and I wanted you to hear it from me before you get home. In last night's storm our big oak came down across your garden: about 4 metres of your back fence is flattened and the greenhouse is smashed. Nobody was hurt. I'm so sorry, I know this is the last thing you want to come back to. I reported it to my insurer this morning, a tree surgeon is clearing it on Saturday morning, and if insurance doesn't cover the fence and greenhouse, I'll pay for them myself. Photos below, and call me any time if you want to talk it through.
note: Lead with the damage and that nobody was hurt, then what is already in motion; check the policy before saying what insurance will pay.

situation: My teammate and close friend Priya and I both applied for the senior analyst role, and I got it. Our manager, Tom, announces it Monday at 10am and said I could tell her first, so I'm telling her in person on Friday. She's been working towards that role for two years.
reply: Priya, have you got five minutes? I wanted you to hear this from me before Monday: I got the senior analyst role. I know you've been working towards it for two years, and I'm not going to pretend that's easy news. Tom's announcing it on Monday at 10. You don't have to say anything now, and whenever you want to talk about it, or not, I'm around.
note: When you are the good news that is their bad news, don't ask for congratulations or explain why you got it; say it plainly and let her react.

situation: I volunteer as an editor for Tidelines, a small poetry anthology. My close friend Mara submitted three poems and none made the final cut; the panel reads every submission blind and we picked 24 out of 310. The results email goes out Monday Oct 5, the next call opens in March, and I want to text her before the email lands.
reply: Mara, I wanted you to hear this from me before Monday's email, and it isn't the news you were hoping for: none of your three poems made it into Tidelines this year. We picked 24 out of 310, and the panel reads everything blind. I know how much of yourself went into those poems, and I'm sorry. The next call opens in March, and I'd love to see more of your work then. I'm around if you want to talk, and it's fine if you don't.
note: When you're both the friend and the gatekeeper, tell her before the form email, keep the reason factual, and promise nothing about next time.

situation: 上个月我在一个网上认识的“理财导师”推荐的平台上投了6万，是我和老公一起攒的存款，现在平台打不开，人也联系不上了。我昨天已经去派出所报了案。老公还不知道，他今晚7点下班回家，我想先发条微信让他有个准备，回家再当面说。
reply: 老公，有件不好的事要告诉你，你先有个心理准备。上个月我没跟你商量，把我们存款里的6万投到了一个网上认识的人推荐的平台，现在平台打不开，人也联系不上，这笔钱很可能是被骗了。这是我们俩一起攒的钱，你生气、失望都是应该的。我昨天已经去派出所报了案，今晚你回来我把所有记录都给你看，我们一起商量下一步。
note: 钱的坏消息别等对方自己发现：先预告，再说清数额和现状，不辩解。之后如果有人说能“帮忙追回”还要先交钱，多半是二次诈骗，先跟警方核实。

situation: My colleague Owen spent two months on a four-day-week pilot proposal, and leadership turned it down at Tuesday's review: they won't consider it before the new financial year in April, though they called his staff survey data strong. Owen wasn't in the room, and our director Hannah asked me to tell him before her formal note goes out on Friday. I was in the review and I'm messaging him on Slack.
reply: Owen, got a minute? I wanted you to hear this from me before Hannah's note on Friday, and it isn't the news you were hoping for: leadership turned down the four-day-week pilot at Tuesday's review. Their reason was timing; they won't consider it before the new financial year in April. I know you put two months into it, and that's a hard one to hear. They did call your staff survey data strong. I'm around whenever you want to hear how the discussion went.
note: When you're the messenger for someone else's decision, give the news and their reason plainly, without softening it or defending it.

situation: Me llamo Inés y alquilo un apartamento turístico en Valencia. Ayer reventó una tubería y el piso estará en obras al menos tres semanas, así que tengo que cancelar la reserva de Marta y Jorge, que llegaban el viernes 9 de octubre para cuatro noches por 480 €. Hoy ya les he devuelto el importe completo, y mi vecina Carmen tiene un apartamento libre esas fechas en la misma calle por 440 €. Les escribo por la plataforma.
reply: Hola, Marta y Jorge: tengo una mala noticia y prefiero contárosla cuanto antes. Tengo que cancelar vuestra reserva del viernes 9 de octubre, porque ayer reventó una tubería y el piso va a estar en obras al menos tres semanas. Sé que esto os complica el viaje, y lo siento mucho. Hoy mismo os he devuelto los 480 € completos. Si os sirve, mi vecina Carmen tiene un apartamento libre esas mismas fechas en la misma calle por 440 €, y os paso su contacto en cuanto me digáis. Inés
note: La noticia en la segunda frase, el reembolso ya hecho y una alternativa sin presión; revisa antes el proceso de cancelación de la plataforma.

situation: 我是小区水果团购的团长。32户邻居一共预付了4800元订阳光玫瑰葡萄，供货商收钱后电话打不通，微信也把我拉黑了。我昨天已经报警，也决定自己先垫付，10月9日前把钱按大家当初的付款方式全部退回。要在团购群里说。
reply: 各位邻居，有个不好的消息要马上告诉大家：这次的阳光玫瑰葡萄发不了货了。供货商收钱后电话打不通，微信也把我拉黑了，我昨天已经报了警。钱是大家交到我这里的，这事我负责：32户一共4800元，我先自己垫付，10月9日前按大家当初的付款方式一一退回。让大家白等一场，真的很抱歉。有任何问题直接私信我。
note: 钱的坏消息：前两句说清，再说谁负责、退多少、哪天退；群里如果有人自称能“帮忙追回”并发链接或要费用，别点也别付，保留报警回执。
